name: Resend Email Verification Code
summary: Request a fresh email-verification code while email ownership remains unverified.

guards.expression: email ownership is not yet verified

forbiddenEffects: Do not create a new durable identity.
Do not change tenant or workspace membership.

sourceReferences.note: Resend is an atomic user action within existing email-verification behaviors. Acceptance and cooldown throttling are scenario/transition outcomes rather than separate action types.
